confirmed_input_semantic_fix.issue: Binance archive kline close timestamp is interval_end-1ms while Pine v2.5.13 uses exact time_close in WINDOW REPORT, news and session boundary logic.
confirmed_input_semantic_fix.fix: For time-based parity bars, normalize close timestamp to open_time + timeframe before calling the exact engine.
confirmed_input_semantic_fix.why_material: The 1ms timestamp difference can delay a session/news cutoff by a full chart candle because Pine tests tc + chartMs against exact cutoffs.
